name: Luzerne County, PA
findings: Luzerne County has 895 nonprofit organizations. 400 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 338 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Luzerne County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few religious organizations list membership
observations.text: 25 religious organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 51 would.

confidence.text: Based on 51 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through religious groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 44 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 44 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
